high_level_description: The image is a meme that showcases three generations of firefighters over the years. The text at the top reads: "3 generations of firefighters: grandfather in 1966, father in 1988 & son in 2015." The image is divided into three vertical sections, each depicting a firefighter from a different generation. Left Section (Grandfather, 1966): The firefighter is wearing a black uniform with a high-collared jacket and trousers. The uniform includes a belt with a buckle and what appears to be a badge or patch on the left side
